basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) Project Scientist - III Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 30 July 2026 on the official website of NIPER. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the NIPER Project Scientist - III Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years as on 14-08-2026. Age relaxation: up to 5 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/SC/ST/Differently Abled/Women candidates.

qualification.education_qualification: PhD with preceding Master's Degree of first class (M.S/M.Pharm/M.Sc) in chemistry or natural product chemistry or equivalent, GATE/CSIR NET qualification mandatory, Minimum three publications with impact factor >3, Experience in natural product isolation, characterization, analytical techniques like HPLC, mass, NMR
qualification.details: Project Scientist - III: PhD with preceding Master's Degree of first class (M.S/M.Pharm/M.Sc) in chemistry or natural product chemistry or equivalent subject related to natural products. GATE/CSIR NET qualification is mandatory. Candidate must have minimum three publications with impact factor>3. Desirable: experience in natural product isolation, characterization, analytical techniques like HPLC, mass, NMR with proven track record in the relevant publications.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIPER to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Project Scientist - III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NIPER Project Scientist - III position is 14 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist - III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD with a preceding Master's Degree of first class (M.S/M.Pharm/M.Sc) in chemistry or natural product chemistry or an equivalent relevant subject. GATE/CSIR NET qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Scientist - III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist - III post is 40 years as of 14 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist - III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this NIPER recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist - III position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist - III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist - III position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this NIPER recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this Project Scientist - III position is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIPER located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: NIPER for this recruitment is located in Guwahati, Assam.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this NIPER Project Scientist - III recruitment is NIPER/G/Project Rectt./2026/02/Re/09.
